resources.string: Learn about ownership of Keyboard X and the proper use of its name, design, and original materials.

The rights to original software, visual designs, graphics, and other materials in Keyboard X belong to their respective rights holders. Third-party components remain subject to their own licenses and terms.
The Keyboard X name, logo, and associated branding must not be used in a way that falsely suggests official approval, affiliation, or endorsement.

Permission to use protected materials may be required unless applicable law or a relevant license allows the use. To report a suspected intellectual property concern, contact the support address listed in the app.
